annotations.title: Companies with a filed reason to buy from you

description: Give the website of the business you sell for. MentionFox reads it to learn what you sell, then searches recent filed events for up to 10 companies with a reason to buy from you now: new funding filings, a new chief executive, finance chief, operations chief or general counsel, IPO filings, activist stakes of 5% or more, layoff filings and state layoff notices, crowdfunding raises and new Y Combinator companies. US companies only. Investment funds and real estate filings are left out. Every result carries the record it came from (record_url, for example the SEC filing or the state notice list), so you can check it yourself; the why_now line is written from that record, and fit is a short note on why the company matches what you sell. searched_feeds lists every feed searched with the date of its newest record. Fewer than 10 means fewer were found; the list is never padded. Costs 1 credit when companies come back; a search that finds none costs nothing. The same search is free to try at https://mentionfox.com/buyers.

days.description: How far back to look: 30 or 90 days.

state.description: Optional. A two-letter US state code (for example TX) to keep only companies based there.

trigger_types.description: Optional. Only these kinds of event (layoff covers layoff filings and state layoff notices). Left out, the kinds that fit what you sell are chosen for you.

url.description: The website of the business you sell for, for example acme.com.
